lines.zh: 夜里沙面凉，我的长腿一蹬就出去老远。
lines.en: The night sand is cool; one push of my long legs carries me far.

lines.zh: 后腿比前腿长，我一跳能越过整丛枯草。
lines.en: My hind legs outgrew the front; I clear a whole tuft of dry grass.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩在沙上，替我拐了个急弯。
lines.en: My tail whips the sand and swings me through a sharp turn.

lines.zh: 白天我把自己埋进沙里，只留鼻尖。
lines.en: By day I bury myself in sand with only my nose showing.

lines.zh: 沙下的洞是我自己挖的，口小肚大。
lines.en: I dug this burrow myself: a narrow mouth, a wide belly.

lines.zh: 耳朵贴着地面，响尾蛇的沙沙声先到了。
lines.en: Ear to the ground, I hear the rattlesnake's dry rattle first.

lines.zh: 狐狸的脚印是新的，我换条路走。
lines.en: Those fox prints are fresh, so I take another route.

lines.zh: 我蹦得低一点，猫的视线就抓不住。
lines.en: I hop lower, and the cat's stare loses me.

lines.zh: 沙子钻进脚趾缝，跑起来有点痒。
lines.en: Sand works between my toes and tickles as I run.

lines.zh: 一根枯枝就够了，我藏在它影子里。
lines.en: A single dry twig is enough; I hide in its shadow.

lines.zh: 夜风里全是种子晒干的味道。
lines.en: The night wind smells of seeds drying in the sun.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙丘脊线跳，那里最省力。
lines.en: I follow the dune's crest, where every hop costs less.

lines.zh: 群星亮起来时，我才敢离洞远些。
lines.en: Only when the stars are out do I stray far from my burrow.

lines.zh: 走一段停一下，听有没有翅膀扑下来。
lines.en: A few hops, then a pause, listening for wings dropping down.

lines.zh: 我一跳一顿，像踩在鼓点上。
lines.en: I hop and pause, like stepping to a drum.

lines.zh: 绕过一丛刺草，我的腿没擦到。
lines.en: I skirt a thorny bush without touching it.

lines.zh: 沙地上的路，走一条换一条。
lines.en: On the sand, I switch trails.

lines.zh: 沙上我一跳就没影。
lines.en: One hop and I'm gone from this sand.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，真烦。
lines.en: My bones keep rattling.

lines.zh: 听见了吗，那是我在磨牙。
lines.en: Hear that? That is me grinding my teeth.

lines.zh: 只往前蹦，回头要费腿。
lines.en: Only hop forward, looking back costs legs.

lines.zh: 一圈沙丘，跳完再一圈。
lines.en: One dune, then another, and another.

lines.zh: 月亮出来，我的腿才醒。
lines.en: My legs wake up when the moon rises.

lines.zh: 沙上我跳着走，脚印很浅。
lines.en: I hop across the sand, leaving shallow prints.

lines.zh: 跳久了，后腿也会酸。
lines.en: Hop long enough and even hind legs ache.

lines.zh: 这沙里有蛇爬过的味。
lines.en: Snake scent in this sand.

lines.zh: 前面有光，那多半不是好事。
lines.en: Light ahead usually means nothing good.

lines.zh: 绕开水坑，我的毛怕湿。
lines.en: Around the puddle, my fur hates water.

lines.zh: 前爪搓一搓，把脸上的沙抹掉。
lines.en: I rub my front paws to wipe the sand off my face.

lines.zh: 我坐着打盹，长腿摊在两边。
lines.en: I doze sitting up, long legs sprawled on either side.

lines.zh: 日头太毒，等它落下去再说。
lines.en: The sun is too fierce; I'll wait for it to drop.

lines.zh: 沙下有虫子翻身，我听见了。
lines.en: Something under the sand rolls over; I hear it.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵折下来，挡住风。
lines.en: I fold my ears down to keep the wind out.

lines.zh: 那颗种子卡在牙缝里，真难受。
lines.en: That seed is stuck between my teeth, and it bothers me.

lines.zh: 昨夜那只猫还在附近转。
lines.en: That cat from last night is still prowling nearby.

lines.zh: 我数沙丘，数到第四座就乱了。
lines.en: I count the dunes and lose track at the fourth.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖轻轻敲着地，是自己的节拍。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the ground, keeping my own rhythm.

lines.zh: 有种子递过来吗，我可以等。
lines.en: Is there a seed for me? I can wait.

lines.zh: 洞里凉，可外面有月光。
lines.en: My burrow is cool, but the moonlight is out here.

lines.zh: 我舔一舔前爪，再抹一遍耳朵。
lines.en: I lick a paw and smooth my ears again.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在动，也可能只是沙。
lines.en: Something moves far off, or maybe it's only sand.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，今晚要跑很远。
lines.en: My belly is empty; tonight I must run far.

lines.zh: 我睁着眼，沙子也不眨。
lines.en: Eyes open, even the sand does not blink.

lines.zh: 跳鼠的耳朵比身子还长。
lines.en: My ears are longer than the rest of me.

lines.zh: 耳朵比身子还长的家伙。
lines.en: The one whose ears are longer than its body.

lines.zh: 星星太多，我只数到三。
lines.en: Too many stars, I only count to three.

lines.zh: 蹲在洞口，脑子也空。
lines.en: Squatting at my burrow with an empty head.

lines.zh: 四条血的我，连狐狸都怕。
lines.en: Four points of health, and even foxes scare me.

lines.zh: 谁在那块石头后面吸气？
lines.en: Who is breathing behind that stone?

lines.zh: 这么小的我，谁都想吃。
lines.en: Small as I am, everyone wants a bite.

lines.zh: 连虫都不叫，太安静了。
lines.en: Not even insects, far too quiet.

lines.zh: 等天黑，等猎物。
lines.en: Wait for dark. Wait for prey.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就敢靠近一点。
lines.en: Stand still, and I'll dare come a little closer.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里有种子的味道。
lines.en: Your pocket smells of seeds.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，我只是太小了。
lines.en: I don't bite; I'm only very small.

lines.zh: 你的影子够长，我可以躲进去。
lines.en: Your shadow is long enough for me to hide in.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的时候，我退了两步。
lines.en: When you bend down, I back away two hops.

lines.zh: 手心里放平，别抓过来。
lines.en: Keep your palm flat; don't grab at me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子仰得发酸。
lines.en: I look up at you until my neck aches.

lines.zh: 你和那只狐狸不一样，我先信一半。
lines.en: You're not like that fox; I'll trust you halfway.

lines.zh: 若你撒下种子，我就跳到你脚边。
lines.en: Scatter seeds, and I'll hop to your feet.

lines.zh: 我鼻子动了三下，记住了你的气味。
lines.en: My nose twitches three times and remembers your scent.

lines.zh: 兔子、狐狸、蛇，都想吃我。
lines.en: Rabbits, foxes, snakes — all want me.

lines.zh: 又是一个送上门来的。
lines.en: Another one walks right in.

lines.zh: 你手里那个亮东西，我看见了。
lines.en: I see that shiny thing in your hand.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，比沙暴还吵。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is noisier than a sandstorm.

lines.zh: 我这么小，狐狸都懒得追。
lines.en: I'm so small the foxes don't bother.

lines.zh: 就你一个来沙漠？胆子不小。
lines.en: Alone in the desert? Bold of you.

lines.zh: 你身上那层壳，能借我躲吗。
lines.en: That shell of yours, can I hide in it?

lines.zh: 你这眼神，像盯沙鼠的狐狸。
lines.en: That look of yours is a fox eyeing a jerboa.

lines.zh: 我一跳半格，你一步一格。
lines.en: I hop half a block while you take a whole one.

lines.zh: 看你走半天，绕回同一块石头。
lines.en: You walked all that way back to the same rock.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，沙色都盖不住发抖。
lines.en: I curl up, and even my sand color can't hide the shaking.

lines.zh: 这一下好重，我腿都站不稳。
lines.en: That hit was heavy; my legs won't hold me.

lines.zh: 我早知道不该靠这么近。
lines.en: I knew I shouldn't have come this close.

lines.zh: 疼得我尾巴都僵了。
lines.en: The pain stiffens my tail.

lines.zh: 别再来一下，我受不住的。
lines.en: Not another one; I can't take it.

lines.zh: 我退到洞口，只想钻进去。
lines.en: I back to the burrow mouth, wanting only to go down.

lines.zh: 血珠渗出来，我舔了舔。
lines.en: A bead of blood wells up; I lick at it.

lines.zh: 我才四点的身板，经不起这个。
lines.en: I'm four points of life; I can't afford this.

lines.zh: 你力气这么大，何必找我。
lines.en: You're this strong; why come after me?

lines.zh: 我跑不动了，腿在打颤。
lines.en: I can't run anymore; my legs are trembling.

lines.zh: 耳朵被削了一角，没事。
lines.en: A corner of my ear is gone, no matter.

lines.zh: 四点血而已，还能蹦。
lines.en: Just four hit points, I can still hop.

lines.zh: 我只有四点血，可我会跳。
lines.en: Four points of life, but I can jump.

lines.zh: 你这一下，打中我的长腿了。
lines.en: That hit caught my long legs.

lines.zh: 我这么小，咬也咬不动。
lines.en: I am so small, my bite barely lands.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我跳的力都打没了。
lines.en: That blow knocked the hop right out of me.

lines.zh: 四点血的家伙，禁不起这一下。
lines.en: A four-hit-point creature cannot take that blow.

lines.zh: 我这么小，狐狸一爪就够。
lines.en: I am so small one fox swipe is enough.

lines.zh: 我躲在沙里，还是被找到。
lines.en: I hide in the sand and still get found.

lines.zh: 让我跳起来，我咬你脚。
lines.en: Let me get up and I will bite your foot.

lines.zh: 是种子，我整只鼠都亮了。
lines.en: Seeds — every bit of me lights up.

lines.zh: 那几粒够我嚼一整夜。
lines.en: Those few grains will keep me chewing all night.

lines.zh: 我跳过去，但还留着一跳的退路。
lines.en: I hop over, but keep one hop of escape in reserve.

lines.zh: 蛆也行，我不挑，真的。
lines.en: Maggots are fine too; I'm not picky, truly.

lines.zh: 先闻一下，别是石头。
lines.en: Let me sniff first, to be sure it isn't a pebble.

lines.zh: 你手别抖，种子会掉的。
lines.en: Don't shake your hand, or the seeds will spill.

lines.zh: 我前爪已经伸出来，忍不了一点。
lines.en: My front paws are already reaching; I can't help it.

lines.zh: 吃完这个，我就不缠你了。
lines.en: One more of these, and I'll stop pestering you.

lines.zh: 种子在沙上，我一次全收走。
lines.en: The seeds are on the sand; I'll take them all at once.

lines.zh: 我嗅到了，甜的，还带壳。
lines.en: I smell it: sweet, and still in its husk.

lines.zh: 四点的命，全靠跳得远。
lines.en: Four points of life, all in the jump.

lines.zh: 我不挑，能塞进嘴的都行。
lines.en: I am not picky, anything bite-sized works.

lines.zh: 我只要那个。
lines.en: I only want that one.

lines.zh: 铁有点咸，磨牙正好。
lines.en: Iron tastes a bit salty, good for my teeth.

lines.zh: 先给我一口。
lines.en: Just one bite first.

lines.zh: 你手里那块，亮得刺眼。
lines.en: That thing in your hand is too bright.

lines.zh: 丢过来，我接着就跑。
lines.en: Toss it over, I will catch it and run.

lines.zh: 你手一晃，我耳朵都跟着抖。
lines.en: Your hand wobbles and my ears twitch along.

lines.zh: 响尾蛇的动静比你的脚步更近。
lines.en: A rattlesnake is closer than your steps.

lines.zh: 我这两条后腿，一跳半米。
lines.en: Two hind legs, half a meter per hop.

lines.zh: 撞上我的，其实是你自己的脚踝。
lines.en: The thing you bumped into is your own ankle.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你居然能踩到。
lines.en: I'm this small, and you still managed to step on me.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要从你腿间穿过。
lines.en: Excuse me, I'm squeezing between your legs.

lines.zh: 我弹开了，像颗被碰到的沙粒。
lines.en: I bounce off like a grain of sand that got nudged.

lines.zh: 别挡洞口，那是我回家的路。
lines.en: Don't block the burrow mouth; that's my way home.

lines.zh: 你的靴子把我撞得转了半圈。
lines.en: Your boot spins me half a circle.

lines.zh: 我落地时尾巴先着地，没事。
lines.en: My tail lands first, so I'm fine.

lines.zh: 沙都被你踩实了，我得重挖。
lines.en: You packed the sand down; now I must dig again.

lines.zh: 我退到一边，把路让给你。
lines.en: I back aside and give you the path.

lines.zh: 两次了，你走路能不能看地。
lines.en: That's twice; could you watch the ground?

lines.zh: 撞得我尾巴都打结了。
lines.en: That hit tangled my tail.

lines.zh: 谁把沙踢到我脸上？
lines.en: Who kicked sand in my face?

lines.zh: 我腿这么细，撞一下就歪。
lines.en: Legs this thin bend at a touch.

lines.zh: 我一蹬后腿，就从你的影子里出去了。
lines.en: One kick of my hind legs and I am out of your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的靴子撞飞我半尺。
lines.en: Your boot knocked me half a block off course.

lines.zh: 我的大耳朵被撞得直响。
lines.en: My big ears are ringing from the bump.

lines.zh: 沙崖边上，差点把我撞下去。
lines.en: You nearly knocked me off the dune's edge.

lines.zh: 我腿太细，站都站不稳。
lines.en: My legs are so thin I can barely stand.

lines.zh: 撞一下不会死。
lines.en: A bump won't kill you.

lines.zh: 这里过不去。
lines.en: No room to pass here.

lines.zh: 我用后腿敲沙，声音传得很远。
lines.en: I drum the sand with my hind legs; it carries far.

lines.zh: 她也把耳朵竖起来了，听见了。
lines.en: She pricks her ears too; she heard it.

lines.zh: 我们绕沙丘追，谁也不肯先停。
lines.en: We chase around the dune, and neither will stop first.

lines.zh: 蛆是我带来的，礼轻但新鲜。
lines.en: I brought maggots: a small gift, but fresh.

lines.zh: 她闻了闻我的耳朵，算是答应了。
lines.en: She sniffs my ear, and that counts as yes.

lines.zh: 两条长尾巴在沙上画了个叉。
lines.en: Two long tails draw a cross in the sand.

lines.zh: 洞要挖深一点，往后有小的要住。
lines.en: The burrow needs digging deeper; little ones will live here.

lines.zh: 她跳得比我高，我认了。
lines.en: She hops higher than I do, and I accept that.

lines.zh: 夜里安静，只听得见彼此落脚。
lines.en: The night is quiet; we hear only each other's landings.

lines.zh: 这一季的沙丘归我们俩。
lines.en: This season, the dune belongs to the two of us.

lines.zh: 沙地上，我的后腿敲得急。
lines.en: On the sand, my hind legs drum fast.

lines.zh: 我咬人很轻的。
lines.en: I bite very gently.

lines.zh: 别理那些村民。
lines.en: Ignore those villagers.

lines.zh: 我牙小，只啃草根。
lines.en: My teeth are small, I only gnaw roots.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像家。
lines.en: You smell like home.

lines.zh: 天亮了，你还敢出来吗？
lines.en: It is dawn, do you still dare come out?

lines.zh: 你那一小嗓子，我听着耳热。
lines.en: That little squeak makes my ears warm.

lines.zh: 跟我回洞里。
lines.en: Come back to my den.

lines.zh: 我们的巢在那边。
lines.en: Our nest is over there.

lines.zh: 沙洞朝南，睡进去不冷。
lines.en: My burrow faces south, it is warm inside.

lines.zh: 这颗种子我塞进颊边，带走。
lines.en: I tuck this seed into my cheek and carry it off.

lines.zh: 捡到一小片干叶，铺洞正好。
lines.en: A scrap of dry leaf, perfect bedding for the burrow.

lines.zh: 这块比我还大，我拖不动。
lines.en: This one is bigger than I am; I can't drag it.

lines.zh: 我把它举过头顶，像举着一面旗。
lines.en: I lift it overhead like a little flag.

lines.zh: 掉在地上就归我了，规矩如此。
lines.en: If it's on the ground, it's mine. That's the rule.

lines.zh: 我先埋起来，回头再来取。
lines.en: I'll bury it now and come back for it later.

lines.zh: 这粒有点潮，得晒一晒。
lines.en: This grain is damp; it needs drying in the sun.

lines.zh: 我爪子里只能夹一样，够了。
lines.en: My paws hold only one thing, and one is enough.

lines.zh: 谁掉的东西，我可不会还。
lines.en: Whoever dropped this isn't getting it back.

lines.zh: 带回去堆在洞口，看着就安心。
lines.en: I'll pile it by the burrow mouth; the sight comforts me.

lines.zh: 这刀口，能撬开硬壳。
lines.en: This edge could pry open a hard shell.

lines.zh: 这铁片，能磨我的牙吗？
lines.en: Can I gnaw on this iron plate?

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我先拖着跑。
lines.en: Something on the ground, I drag it and run.

lines.zh: 沙缝里那点亮，是我的。
lines.en: That glint in the sand crack is mine.

lines.zh: 拿着，砸人用。
lines.en: I'll take it. For hitting.

lines.zh: 拖着走，得跳半步歇半步。
lines.en: Heavy, I hop a little and rest a little.

lines.zh: 这亮片，塞进洞里刚好。
lines.en: This shiny bit fits my burrow just right.

lines.zh: 捡起来塞进腮帮里。
lines.en: Pick it up and stuff it in my cheek.

lines.zh: 沙漠里，我一跳能越过三丛草。
lines.en: In the desert, one hop clears three bushes.

lines.zh: 别盯着，我又不给你。
lines.en: Stop watching, I am not sharing.

lines.zh: 那条蛇的响环一响，我就绷紧了。
lines.en: The moment that rattler's tail sounds, I go rigid.

lines.zh: 狐狸的影子压过来，我先跑为敬。
lines.en: A fox's shadow falls; I leave first and ask nothing.

lines.zh: 猫伏低了，我知道那是什么意思。
lines.en: The cat crouches low, and I know what that means.

lines.zh: 有东西在洞口闻，我屏住气。
lines.en: Something sniffs at my burrow; I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 那不是风，是爪子刮沙的声音。
lines.en: That's not wind; that's claws scraping sand.

lines.zh: 我退到枯草后面，腿已经准备好。
lines.en: I back behind the dry grass, legs already loaded.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落下来，我盯着它的影子。
lines.en: A bird lands; I watch its shadow, not the bird.

lines.zh: 沙面一震一震，有大的在走。
lines.en: The sand thumps softly; something large is walking.

lines.zh: 我不打，我只会跑，跑得很快。
lines.en: I don't fight; I only run, and I run well.

lines.zh: 洞口被堵住之前，我得出去。
lines.en: I must get out before the burrow mouth is blocked.

lines.zh: 两只眼睛在夜里发亮，不是同类。
lines.en: Two eyes shine in the dark, and they aren't my kind.

lines.zh: 闻到血味了，附近有谁吃了东西。
lines.en: I smell blood; someone nearby has eaten.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道真浓，是蛇吗？
lines.en: Your scent is strong; a snake?

lines.zh: 沙底下有动静，我耳朵先竖起。
lines.en: Something moves under the sand; my ears rise first.

lines.zh: 响尾蛇的尾巴，就在后面响。
lines.en: The rattlesnake is sounding right behind me.

lines.zh: 我后腿一蹬，从你脚边绕开。
lines.en: One kick of my hind legs and I am around your feet.

lines.zh: 沙里一响，我的大耳朵先竖起来。
lines.en: One sound in the sand and my big ears go up.

lines.zh: 同伴们，这边，洞在这边。
lines.en: Kin, over here; the burrow is this way.

lines.zh: 沙上有影子，我先看见的。
lines.en: A shadow on the sand and I saw it first.

lines.zh: 你嗓门这么大，震得我耳朵疼。
lines.en: Your voice rattles my ears.

lines.zh: 那阵咚咚的，是你的心吧。
lines.en: That thumping, is it your heart?

lines.zh: 这么重的脚步，跑不过我。
lines.en: Footsteps that heavy cannot outrun me.

lines.zh: 沙在震……有东西靠近。
lines.en: The sand trembles, something is coming.

lines.zh: 就你，缩在草后面。
lines.en: You, hiding behind the grass.

lines.zh: 沙漠的夜，我耳朵比眼睛大。
lines.en: Desert night: my ears are bigger than my eyes.

lines.zh: 冲我来的？那我先跳。
lines.en: Coming for me? Then I hop first.

lines.zh: 沙下的洞，让我先看见你。
lines.en: The burrow under the sand lets me see you first.

lines.zh: 我只有四点血，先蹦为敬。
lines.en: Four hit points, so I hop first.

lines.zh: 它每靠近一步，我就往后挪半步。
lines.en: Each step it takes, I give back half a step.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的脚，不看它的牙。
lines.en: I watch its feet, not its teeth.

lines.zh: 心跳太快，我自己都听得见。
lines.en: My heart beats so hard I can hear it myself.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就钻洞了。
lines.en: One step closer, and I'm down the burrow.

lines.zh: 它绕左边，我就往右边挪。
lines.en: It circles left, so I shift right.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，沙色盖住我。
lines.en: I flatten myself; my sand color covers me.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就蹦出去三丈。
lines.en: It twitches, and I'm three bounds away.

lines.zh: 我在等它先露出破绽。
lines.en: I'm waiting for it to show a gap.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬得发酸，我还不能停。
lines.en: My hind legs burn, but I can't stop yet.

lines.zh: 洞口就在身后，我数着距离。
lines.en: The burrow is behind me; I'm counting the distance.

lines.zh: 它喘气的声音比脚步更近。
lines.en: Its breathing sounds closer than its steps.

lines.zh: 只要有一线空隙，我就能穿过去。
lines.en: Give me one gap, and I'll slip through it.

lines.zh: 你喘成这样，还跑什么。
lines.en: Breathing like that, why run at all.

lines.zh: 你掉了块铁，我帮你追。
lines.en: You dropped iron, I will chase it for you.

lines.zh: 沙漠的夜，我躲得最好。
lines.en: In the desert night, I hide best.

lines.zh: 沙丘到头了，没洞可钻。
lines.en: The dune ends here and there is no burrow.

lines.zh: 别往石头后面缩，我看得见。
lines.en: Do not shrink behind that rock, I see you.

lines.zh: 你踩过的沙印，一个比一个深。
lines.en: Your prints in the sand grow deeper each step.

lines.zh: 等我……我腿短，先别跑。
lines.en: Wait for me, my legs are short, do not run yet.

lines.zh: 风里有你，还混着铁。
lines.en: The wind carries you, mixed with iron.

lines.zh: 你的每一步，我都数着。
lines.en: I count every step you take.

lines.zh: 栅栏缝里，我挤得进去。
lines.en: I can squeeze through a fence gap.

lines.zh: 脚步停了？那我就上去看看。
lines.en: Footsteps stopped? Then I will come look.

lines.zh: 沙窝里一钻，你就找不着。
lines.en: One dive into the sand burrow, and I am lost.

lines.zh: 再跑也没用，我跳得比你快。
lines.en: Running won't help, I hop faster than you.

lines.zh: 夜里我睁着眼，你一停我就到。
lines.en: I do not sleep, the moment you stop I am there.

lines.zh: 四条细腿一跳，沙就动了。
lines.en: Four thin legs hop, and the sand moves.

lines.zh: 沙地上的响尾蛇，我听着。
lines.en: I listen for the rattler on the sand.

lines.zh: 沙漠里响尾蛇也追我，你算什么。
lines.en: Rattlesnakes chase me; you are nothing new.

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我直接蹦过沙丘。
lines.en: You turn and I hop straight over the dune.

lines.zh: 慢点，我的腿是跳的不是跑的。
lines.en: Slow down, my legs hop rather than run.

lines.zh: 我的后腿，已经绷紧。
lines.en: My hind legs are already tensed.

lines.zh: 我咬它鼻子，那是唯一够得着的地方。
lines.en: I bite its nose; it's the only part I can reach.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬出去，也就踢起一蓬沙。
lines.en: My hind legs kick out and throw up a puff of sand.

lines.zh: 沙扬进它眼睛，我趁乱跑。
lines.en: Sand flies into its eyes; I run in the confusion.

lines.zh: 我扑上去又弹开，像颗石子。
lines.en: I lunge and bounce away like a thrown pebble.

lines.zh: 这一口很轻，我的牙只够啃壳。
lines.en: This bite is light; my teeth only crack husks.

lines.zh: 我撞它一下，自己先滚了两圈。
lines.en: I ram it once and roll twice myself.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽在它脸上，然后我就逃。
lines.en: My tail lashes its face, and then I flee.

lines.zh: 别怨我，是你的手先伸过来。
lines.en: Don't resent me; your hand reached out first.

lines.zh: 我咬住又松开，只为争一点时间。
lines.en: I bite and let go, only buying a moment.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我腿都软了。
lines.en: After that one hit, my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 小也要咬你一口。
lines.en: Small, but I still bite.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一条沙蛇吗？
lines.en: Can you block a sand snake?

lines.zh: 看清楚，我是怎么蹦上来的。
lines.en: Watch closely how I hop up here.

lines.zh: 爪子出去了，收不住。
lines.en: The claws are out, I cannot pull them back.

lines.zh: 爪子蹭到了，血在渗。
lines.en: The claws grazed you, blood is seeping.

lines.zh: 沙子烫脚，我只能跳着走。
lines.en: The sand burns; I can only hop.

lines.zh: 小是小，抓痕够长。
lines.en: Small as I am, the scratch runs long.

lines.zh: 咬住一口，我就往后跳。
lines.en: One bite and I leap back.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我蹦两步。
lines.en: You step back and I hop twice.

lines.zh: 我一跳，比你的脚快。
lines.en: My hop is faster than your foot.

lines.zh: 站好，别让我蹦空。
lines.en: Stand still, do not make me miss.

lines.zh: 爪子够长，够着你脚踝。
lines.en: These claws are long enough to reach your ankle.

lines.zh: 再蹦一下，就够着你腰。
lines.en: One more hop and I reach your waist.

lines.zh: 我的后腿一蹬，比拳重。
lines.en: One kick of my hind legs beats a fist.

lines.zh: 我这后腿一蹬，能跳出老远。
lines.en: These hind legs can launch me far.

lines.zh: 四根小指甲，够你疼。
lines.en: Four little claws, enough to make you sting.

lines.zh: 我的后腿比身体长。
lines.en: My hind legs are longer than my body.

lines.zh: 这招我在沙丘上练了一夜。
lines.en: I practiced this on the dunes all night.

lines.zh: 我的牙，能咬穿你的靴。
lines.en: My teeth can bite through your boot.

lines.zh: 挨我一爪子，叫得出来吗？
lines.en: Can you even cry out after my claw?

lines.zh: 沙丘背风处，我从夜里钻出来。
lines.en: In the lee of a dune, I come out into the night.

lines.zh: 第一件事是抖掉背上的沙。
lines.en: First thing, I shake the sand off my back.

lines.zh: 月亮够亮，今晚能跑很远。
lines.en: The moon is bright; I can range far tonight.

lines.zh: 我从浅洞爬出来，洞口还热。
lines.en: I climb from a shallow burrow still warm from the day.

lines.zh: 这片沙漠夜里归我们这些小东西。
lines.en: At night this desert belongs to us small things.

lines.zh: 我伸开长腿，先试跳一下。
lines.en: I stretch my long legs and try one hop.

lines.zh: 远处有响尾蛇，我记下了方向。
lines.en: A rattler sounds far off; I mark the direction.

lines.zh: 沙面上全是我没见过的脚印。
lines.en: The sand is covered in prints I've never seen.

lines.zh: 刚睁眼，世界大得吓人。
lines.en: My eyes just opened, and the world is frighteningly large.

lines.zh: 我竖起耳朵，把整个夜晚听一遍。
lines.en: I raise my ears and listen the whole night through.

lines.zh: 先找点吃的。
lines.en: First, find something to eat.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙子比我的耳朵还长。
lines.en: The desert sand is longer than my ears.

lines.zh: 沙漠夜里，我蹦出来了。
lines.en: Desert night — and out I hop.

lines.zh: 我落在空地上了，没洞。
lines.en: I landed in the open with no burrow.

lines.zh: 大耳朵贴着沙，我听见你。
lines.en: Big ears on the sand. I hear you.

lines.zh: 沙太软，脚一踩就陷。
lines.en: The sand is so soft I sink in.

lines.zh: 沙洞还在，我回来了。
lines.en: My burrow is still here, I am back.

lines.zh: 四条细腿刚落地，先看天。
lines.en: Four thin legs just landed, so first I check the sky.

lines.zh: 沙漠的夜，凉得刚好。
lines.en: Desert night, cool and just right.

lines.zh: 太阳太亮，我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The sun is too bright, I cannot open my eyes.

lines.zh: 让开，这片沙我先占了。
lines.en: Move aside, I claimed this sand first.

lines.zh: 沙土的味道，闻着安心。
lines.en: Dust smells like home.

lines.zh: 火燎到耳朵，我整只鼠都跳起来。
lines.en: Flame singes my ear, and I leap straight up.

lines.zh: 皮在响，快灭掉。
lines.en: My skin crackles. Put it out.

lines.zh: 落地时后腿一软，滚了半圈。
lines.en: My hind legs give on landing, and I roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 地面怎么这么硬。
lines.en: Why is the ground so hard?

lines.zh: 水比沙难爬多了，我拼命划。
lines.en: Water is harder than sand to climb; I paddle hard.

lines.zh: 水里有沙子，更难受。
lines.en: Water with sand in it is worse.

lines.zh: 巨响把我掀出去，耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: The blast throws me; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 我的长后腿白长了。
lines.en: My long legs did nothing for me.

lines.zh: 箭擦过肋侧，钉在身后的沙里。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my ribs and sticks in the sand behind.

lines.zh: 一根刺卡在我腿里。
lines.en: A barb is stuck in my leg.

lines.zh: 有股力量攥住我，冷得刺骨。
lines.en: Something grips me, and it is cold to the bone.

lines.zh: 身上在发烫。
lines.en: My body's burning hot.

lines.zh: 肚子贴着脊背，我翻不动沙了。
lines.en: My belly touches my spine; I can't turn the sand.

lines.zh: 饿得后腿都发软了。
lines.en: Hungry enough that my hind legs give out.

lines.zh: 天光一闪，我整只鼠都炸了毛。
lines.en: The sky flashes, and every hair on me stands up.

lines.zh: 头发都竖起来了。
lines.en: My hair's standing up.

lines.zh: 下面没有沙，只有无尽的空。
lines.en: There's no sand below, only endless emptiness.

lines.zh: 虚空里连声音都没有，我的耳朵白长了。
lines.en: Not a sound in the void; these big ears are wasted.
